```{r}
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr); library(tibble); library(ggplot2)
root <- normalizePath('.', mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(root, 'r', 'joint_basket_allocation.R'))
source(file.path(root, 'r', 'joint_basket_walk_forward.R'))
audit <- '/run/media/drwho1985/Sandisk/data/beijing-lot/audits/joint-basket-oos-v1'
stopifnot(dir.exists(audit))
cfg <- list(unit_cny = 2, payout_factor = 0.65, tickets_per_issue = 128L, n_folds = 5L,
            exponents = c(0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3))
```

## 结论摘要

在「赔率只能反推」的口径下，**选票没有优化空间**（同源反推下 `E[gross]` 恒等于 1.3）。
本交付审计剩下的两个旋钮：**选场**与**分配**。

1. **选场没有自由度。** 784 期场次数**恒为 7 的倍数**，`k_max = nf %/% 7` 把全部场次
   切成互不相交的 7 元组，**零浪费**。没有任何一场被排除，篮子集合是给定的。
2. **分配池固定。** 每期 `sum(tickets) == 128` 恒成立，分配只是**同期内部**的注码搬运，
   从不改变买哪些场次。
3. **唯一可优化量是 `mass -> 注数` 的形状**，而它在样本外**没有稳定收益**。
4. **7 串 1 的真实 ROI 是 −1.2282%（784 期）**，换算到每腿 **+6.160%**，
   距盈亏平衡 **−0.188pp/腿**。这个结构已经非常接近自我维持。

**主判断：分配维度已被证明无稳定空间；缺口在命中率与派奖的联合结构里，不在怎么分。**

## 输入与契约

只读 254 冻结产物。`gross_if_hit` 是**篮子在该注数下的派奖总额**，
这一点用与冻结 `returns.csv` 的逐期比对定死。

```{r}
baskets <- read_csv(file.path(audit, 'baskets.csv'), show_col_types = FALSE)
gross   <- read_csv(file.path(audit, 'basket_gross.csv'), show_col_types = FALSE)
legs    <- read_csv(file.path(audit, 'legs.csv'), show_col_types = FALSE)
returns <- read_csv(file.path(audit, 'returns.csv'), show_col_types = FALSE)

bg <- baskets |>
  select(issue, group, tickets, mass, hit, rank_full, restricted_mass, all_top2) |>
  inner_join(gross |> select(issue, basket, gross_if_hit) |> rename(group = basket),
             by = c('issue', 'group'), relationship = 'one-to-one') |>
  mutate(issue = as.character(issue),
         stake = tickets * cfg$unit_cny,
         unit_gross = jb_unit_gross(gross_if_hit, tickets, cfg$unit_cny))

stopifnot(nrow(bg) == nrow(baskets), !anyNA(bg$unit_gross))

tibble(
  项目 = c('期数', '篮子数', '每期注数', '每期投注额(元)', '篮子命中率', '期命中率'),
  值 = c(as.character(n_distinct(bg$issue)), format(nrow(bg), big.mark = ','),
         as.character(unique(bg |> group_by(issue) |> summarise(n = sum(tickets)) |> pull(n))),
         as.character(unique(bg |> group_by(issue) |> summarise(s = sum(stake)) |> pull(s))),
         sprintf('%.4f', mean(bg$hit)), sprintf('%.4f', mean(bg |> group_by(issue) |> summarise(h = any(hit)) |> pull(h)))))
```

## 一、量纲定死：`gross_if_hit` 是篮子总额

三种假设对 784 期逐期比对冻结 `returns.csv`：

```{r}
rt <- returns |> mutate(issue = as.character(issue)) |> select(issue, rt_gross = gross)
issue_diff <- function(pay) {
  bg |> mutate(p = ifelse(hit, pay, 0)) |> group_by(issue) |> summarise(p = sum(p)) |>
    inner_join(rt, by = 'issue') |> mutate(d = abs(p - rt_gross)) |> pull(d) |> max()
}
tibble(
  假设 = c('stake * gross_if_hit (按注)', 'gross_if_hit (篮子总额)', 'tickets * gross_if_hit'),
  逐期最大绝对差 = c(issue_diff(bg$stake * bg$gross_if_hit),
                      issue_diff(bg$gross_if_hit),
                      issue_diff(bg$tickets * bg$gross_if_hit)))
```

只有「篮子总额」一栏为零。基线复现：

```{r}
mine <- bg |> mutate(p = ifelse(hit, gross_if_hit, 0)) |> group_by(issue) |> summarise(p = sum(p))
chk  <- returns |> mutate(issue = as.character(issue)) |> select(issue, gross) |> inner_join(mine, by = 'issue')
tibble(项目 = c('我方合计', '冻结 returns 合计', '逐期最大绝对差'),
       值 = c(sprintf('%.8f', sum(chk$p)), sprintf('%.8f', sum(chk$gross)),
              sprintf('%.2e', max(abs(chk$p - chk$gross)))))
```

## 二、`rank_full` 是事后信息

`quarto/254_joint_basket_out_of_sample.qmd:93` 用**已结算结果**在全空间 2187 个元组里查排名。
因此 `rank_full`、`rank_restricted`、`all_top2`、`model_mean_rank` **全部是事后量**，
不能作为分配依据。

```{r}
bg |> filter(rank_full <= 1 | rank_full <= 2 | rank_full <= 5 | rank_full <= 10 | rank_full <= 50 | rank_full > 200) |>
  mutate(分层 = case_when(rank_full <= 1 ~ '≤1', rank_full <= 2 ~ '≤2', rank_full <= 5 ~ '≤5',
                          rank_full <= 10 ~ '≤10', rank_full <= 50 ~ '≤50', TRUE ~ '>200')) |>
  group_by(分层) |>
  summarise(n = n(), 命中率 = mean(hit), .groups = 'drop') |>
  arrange(factor(分层, levels = c('≤1','≤2','≤5','≤10','≤50','>200')))
```

## 三、分配规则：全样本 vs 样本外

```{r}
rule_roi <- function(e) jb_rule_return(bg |> rename(tickets0 = tickets), e, cfg$tickets_per_issue, cfg$unit_cny)
full <- tibble(
  规则 = c('现状 (as-recorded)', paste0('mass^', cfg$exponents[-1])),
  全样本ROI = c(rule_roi(NA_real_), vapply(cfg$exponents[-1], rule_roi, numeric(1))))
full |> mutate(全样本ROI = sprintf('%+.4f%%', 100 * 全样本ROI))
```

`mass^2` 在全样本上为正。**必须做样本外。**

```{r}
d <- bg |> mutate(issue = as.character(issue), tickets0 = tickets) |>
  inner_join(returns |> mutate(issue = as.character(issue)) |> select(issue, date), by = 'issue')
issue_order <- d |> distinct(issue, date) |> arrange(date) |> pull(issue)

# expanding-window walk-forward: exponent chosen strictly on prior issues
wf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(cfg$n_folds)[-1], function(i) {
  folds <- jb_walk_forward_folds(issue_order, cfg$n_folds)
  past <- issue_order[issue_order %in% unlist(folds[seq_len(i - 1)], use.names = FALSE)]
  fut  <- folds[[i]]
  dp <- d |> filter(issue %in% past); df <- d |> filter(issue %in% fut)
  pr <- vapply(cfg$exponents, function(e) jb_rule_return(dp, e, cfg$tickets_per_issue, cfg$unit_cny), numeric(1))
  ch <- cfg$exponents[which.max(pr)]
  tibble(折 = i, 选中指数 = ch, 过去ROI = max(pr), n_过去期数 = length(past),
         样本外ROI = jb_rule_return(df, ch, cfg$tickets_per_issue, cfg$unit_cny),
         同折基线ROI = jb_rule_return(df, NA_real_, cfg$tickets_per_issue, cfg$unit_cny),
         n_样本外期数 = length(fut))
}))
wf |> mutate(across(c(过去ROI, 样本外ROI, 同折基线ROI), ~ sprintf('%+.4f%%', 100 * .x)))
```

**折间从 −32.6% 到 +16.9%。** 合并样本外 ROI 与基线：

```{r}
pool <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(cfg$n_folds)[-1], function(i) {
  folds <- jb_walk_forward_folds(issue_order, cfg$n_folds)
  past <- issue_order[issue_order %in% unlist(folds[seq_len(i - 1)], use.names = FALSE)]
  dp <- d |> filter(issue %in% past)
  pr <- vapply(cfg$exponents, function(e) jb_rule_return(dp, e, cfg$tickets_per_issue, cfg$unit_cny), numeric(1))
  df_i <- d |> filter(issue %in% folds[[i]])
  df_i$tk <- jb_rule_tickets(df_i, cfg$exponents[which.max(pr)], cfg$tickets_per_issue)
  df_i
}))
tibble(项目 = c('合并样本外 ROI (指数在过去选)', '合并样本外 ROI (as-recorded)'),
       值 = c(sprintf('%+.4f%%', 100 * jb_alloc_realised(pool$tk, pool$unit_gross, pool$hit, cfg$unit_cny)),
              sprintf('%+.4f%%', 100 * jb_alloc_realised(pool$tickets0, pool$unit_gross, pool$hit, cfg$unit_cny))))
```

## 四、样本外优势来自一个篮子

```{r}
pool <- pool |> mutate(pay = ifelse(hit, tk * cfg$unit_cny * unit_gross, 0))
drop_tbl <- tibble(
  处理 = c('全部', paste0('去掉最大 ', c(1, 2, 3, 5), ' 个篮子'), '同折基线'),
  样本外ROI = c(
    vapply(c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5), function(k) {
      b <- if (k == 0) pool else pool[-order(-pool$pay)[seq_len(k)], ]
      jb_alloc_realised(b$tk, b$unit_gross, b$hit, cfg$unit_cny)
    }, numeric(1)),
    jb_alloc_realised(pool$tickets0, pool$unit_gross, pool$hit, cfg$unit_cny))) |>
  mutate(样本外ROI = sprintf('%+.4f%%', 100 * 样本外ROI))
drop_tbl
```

## 五、为什么必然如此

```{r}
mx <- bg |> group_by(issue) |> slice_max(mass, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> ungroup()
tibble(
  metric = c('命中率', '平均单位派奖(元/2元注)'),
  最大mass篮 = c(mean(mx$hit), mean(mx$unit_gross)),
  全部篮 = c(mean(bg$hit), mean(bg$unit_gross))) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))
```

`mass` 与命中率 **正相关**、与单位派奖 **负相关**，两者几乎抵消。

```{r}
tibble(关系 = c('corr(mass, hit)', 'corr(mass, unit_gross)'),
       值 = c(cor(bg$mass, as.numeric(bg$hit)), cor(bg$mass, bg$unit_gross))) |>
  mutate(值 = round(值, 4))
```

## 六、结构约束与缺口

```{r}
nf <- legs |> distinct(issue, provider_id) |> count(issue, name = 'nf')
nb <- legs |> count(issue, basket, name = 'n') |> count(issue, name = 'nb')
full <- nf |> inner_join(nb, by = 'issue') |> mutate(used = nb * 7L, wasted = nf - used, k_max = nf %/% 7L)
tibble(
  项目 = c('场次数恒为 7 的倍数', '总场次', '已用场次', '浪费场次', 'k_max == 篮数占比'),
  值 = c(as.character(all(full$nf %% 7L == 0L)), as.character(sum(full$nf)), as.character(sum(full$used)),
         as.character(sum(full$wasted)), sprintf('%.4f', mean(full$k_max == full$nb))))
```

每腿口径的盈亏平衡与实测：

```{r}
roi_realised <- sum(chk$p) / sum(returns$stake) - 1
tibble(
  口径 = c('784 期实测 ROI', '换算每腿毛利', '盈亏平衡每腿 (N=7)', '缺口'),
  值 = c(sprintf('%+.4f%%', 100 * roi_realised),
         sprintf('%+.4f%%', 100 * jb_implied_leg_edge(roi_realised, 7L, cfg$payout_factor)),
         sprintf('%+.4f%%', 100 * jb_breakeven_leg_edge(7L, cfg$payout_factor)),
         sprintf('%+.4f pp', 100 * (jb_implied_leg_edge(roi_realised, 7L, cfg$payout_factor) -
                                     jb_breakeven_leg_edge(7L, cfg$payout_factor)))))
```

## 限制

- 只读 254 冻结产物，未重算、未拟合、未引入新参数。
- 分配规则的评估依赖**真实派奖**；4659 个篮子中仅 **346 个命中**，
  任何分配结论的**有效样本是命中篮子数**，不是篮子数。
- `rank_full` / `rank_restricted` / `all_top2` / `model_mean_rank` 是事后量，本轮全部排除。
- 指数网格仅 7 个点；折数为 5，样本外每折约 157 期。
